newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sweden says may meet EMU criteria this year.
newsitem.headline: Sweden says may meet EMU criteria this year.

text.p: Sweden may meet the criteria for joining the EU's planned economic and monetary union this year, Prime Minister Goran Persson said on Thursday.

Persson, speaking to reporters ahead of a meeting of EU leaders in Dublin, predicted that several EU countries would meet the conditions for monetary union, which include limits on government debt and borrowing.

"Sweden may reach them already this year," he said, adding that data on the Swedish economy indicated that the 1996 budget deficit would fall to below three percent, the target ceiling set by the EU's Maastricht treaty.
